visual_audit: 68/68 original-PDF pages reviewed via 12 contact sheets and page renders

key_figures.question: Q1
key_figures.figure: Figs. 3-18 processing examples and Table 5 confusion metrics
key_figures.role: show how each classical detector contributes and quantify three-image pixel classification performance
key_figures.cannot_prove: generalization to unseen boreholes or correctness of TP/FP/FN without reference-mask provenance

key_figures.question: Q2
key_figures.figure: Figs. 20-31 cluster/fitting overlays, Fig.28 distributions, Table 6 model comparison, Table 7 parameters
key_figures.role: make cluster fragmentation, fit quality, parameter distributions and model-family comparison visible
key_figures.cannot_prove: significance from p-values with no test protocol, or necessity of free period despite known cylindrical geometry

key_figures.question: Q3
key_figures.figure: Figs.33-40 profile fits and sampling curves; Table 8 sampling JRC values
key_figures.role: show multiscale fit behavior and numerical sensitivity of JRC to sampling budget/strategy
key_figures.cannot_prove: physical accuracy of adaptive sampling without independent roughness truth; convergence to a dense numerical result is not ground truth

key_figures.question: Q4
key_figures.figure: Figs.41-49 3D fractures/network/probability matrix/uncertainty/coverage/recommended holes plus Tables 10-12
key_figures.role: communicate the complete geometry-to-network-to-placement decision chain
key_figures.cannot_prove: calibrated connectivity probabilities, posterior uncertainty, expected information gain or full hard-constraint feasibility without code/data replay

recommended_figure_rules: segmentation metric figures must name the reference-mask provenance and holdout unit; background-dominated accuracy should not replace fracture IoU/F1
periodic-fitting comparison must show physical period reference, residual/inlier diagnostics and rejected fits; p-value labels need test/sample-unit annotation
roughness sampling plots should label the dense result as numerical reference unless external truth exists and should show estimate-vs-N plus computation budget
active-drilling maps must plot existing and candidate holes with all exclusion-radius circles so hard feasibility is visible before utility ranking
connectivity heatmaps must label scores as calibrated probabilities only when calibration evidence exists
